$comment: Warning waivers per the HIVE brief: each records owner, reason, expiry, and retest. approvalStatus is 'proposed' until Kody explicitly ratifies in writing (then it becomes 'ratified' with ratifiedOn). scripts/audit-gate.mjs treats matched-but-proposed waivers as HOLD (exit 3), never as approval; it also verifies each waiver's package and severity against the live audit report and enforces expiry so waived findings resurface.

waivers.reason: Build-time image parsing inside Metro (expo dev chain). DoS-only (infinite loop on crafted ICNS); no confidentiality impact; all images parsed at build time are repo-controlled generated PNGs. No fixed version is published on npm (latest is 2.0.2, advisory covers <=2.0.2).
waivers.retest: Recheck monthly, on every lockfile or Expo change, before any release candidate, and at expiry; remove this waiver as soon as a fixed image-size release ships. Compensating control: audit:gate rejects tracked ICNS/JXL/HEIF/HEIC assets (by extension AND file signature) while this advisory is present.
waivers.approvalReference: Proposed under the PM RETURN directives of 2026-08-21; Kody has not yet ratified
